title: Syed Ali Hajvery Institute of Technology and Management Sciences Lahore Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Syed Ali Hajvery Institute of Technology and Management Sciences Lahore Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXI OF 2002
SYED
ALI HAJVERY INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY AND MANAGEMENT SCIENCES, LAHORE ORDINANCE,
2002 .
ORDINANCE XXI OF 2002
An Ordinance o
provide for the establishment of the Syed Ali Hajvery Institute of technology
and Management Sciences, Lahore.
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 10th April, 2002]
No.Legis.13-80/2000, dated
10-4-2002.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Syed Ali Hajvery
Institute of Technology and Management Sciences, Lahore, Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

(c) "Institute" means
